SELECT DISTINCT vcr.user_id AS visitUserId, vcr.visit_time AS visitTime, u.avatar, u.user_name AS visitUserName, (select count(*) from user_card_list ucl where ucl.card_id=bc.card_id and ucl.user_id=#{userId}) as userCardListCount, (select m.status from message_info m where m.by_user_id=#{userId} and m.platform_id=bc.card_id and m.type=1 and m.state=6) as messageStatus, bc.card_id as card_id FROM visit_card_record vcr LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON vcr.user_id = u.user_id left join business_card bc on bc.user_id=vcr.user_id AND bc.audit_status = 1 AND bc.card_status = 1 WHERE vcr.card_id = #{cardId} GROUP BY visitUserName ORDER BY vcr.visit_time DESC

SELECT a.card_id as visitCardId, a.user_id as visitUserId, a.visit_source as visitSource, a.visit_time as visitTime, b.avatar, b.user_name as visitUserName, (select count(*) from user_card_list ucl where ucl.card_id=a.card_id and ucl.user_id=#{userId}) as userCardListCount, (select m.status from message_info m where m.by_user_id=#{userId} and m.platform_id=a.card_id and m.type=1 and m.state=6) as messageStatus, c.* FROM `visit_card_record` a LEFT JOIN business_card c on a.card_id = c.card_id AND c.audit_status = 1 AND c.card_status = 1 LEFT JOIN tb_user b on c.user_id=a.user_id WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY visitUserName, visitCardId order by a.visit_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM ( SELECT vcr.card_id AS visitCardId, u.user_name AS visitUserName FROM visit_card_record vcr LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON vcr.user_id = u.user_id WHERE card_id = #{cardId} GROUP BY visitUserName, visitCardId ) AS t
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS total_count FROM visit_card_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
